original_prompt: Create a CloudFormation template that builds a three-tier VPC with public, application, and database subnets across three availability zones.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Create a CloudFormation template that builds a three-tier VPC with public, application, and database subnets across three availability zones.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Three-tier VPC across three Availability Zones with public, application, and database subnets, NAT gateways, routing, S3 gateway endpoint, and VPC flow logs.

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: three-tier
    Description: Prefix used for resource names and tags.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  PublicSubnetCidrs:
    Type: List<AWS::EC2::CIDR>
    Default:
      - 10.0.0.0/20
      - 10.0.16.0/20
      - 10.0.32.0/20
    Description: CIDR blocks for the public subnets across three AZs.
  AppSubnetCidrs:
    Type: List<AWS::EC2::CIDR>
    Default:
      - 10.0.128.0/20
      - 10.0.144.0/20
      - 10.0.160.0/20
    Description: CIDR blocks for the application subnets across three AZs.
  DbSubnetCidrs:
    Type: List<AWS::EC2::CIDR>
    Default:
      - 10.0.192.0/20
      - 10.0.208.0/20
      - 10.0.224.0/20
    Description: CIDR blocks for the database subnets across three AZs.
  FlowLogsRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 90
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 3653
    Description: CloudWatch Logs retention in days for VPC Flow Logs.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-vpc
        - Key: Tier
          Value: network

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-igw

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Ref PublicSubnetCidrs]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-public-az1
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public
  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Ref PublicSubnetCidrs]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-public-az2
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public
  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Ref PublicSubnetCidrs]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-public-az3
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  AppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Ref AppSubnetCidrs]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-app-az1
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application
  AppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Ref AppSubnetCidrs]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-app-az2
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application
  AppSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Ref AppSubnetCidrs]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-app-az3
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application

  DbSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Ref DbSubnetCidrs]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-db-az1
        - Key: Tier
          Value: database
  DbSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Ref DbSubnetCidrs]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-db-az2
        - Key: Tier
          Value: database
  DbSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Ref DbSubnetCidrs]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-db-az3
        - Key: Tier
          Value: database

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-public-rt

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3

  NatEipAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-nat-eip-az1
  NatEipAz2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-nat-eip-az2
  NatEipAz3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-nat-eip-az3

  NatGatewayAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEipAz1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-nat-az1
  NatGatewayAz2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEipAz2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-nat-az2
  NatGatewayAz3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEipAz3.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-nat-az3

  AppRouteTableAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-app-rt-az1
  AppRouteTableAz2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-app-rt-az2
  AppRouteTableAz3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-app-rt-az3

  AppDefaultRouteAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableAz1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayAz1
  AppDefaultRouteAz2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableAz2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayAz2
  AppDefaultRouteAz3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableAz3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayAz3

  AppSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableAz1
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet1
  AppSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableAz2
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet2
  AppSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableAz3
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet3

  DbRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-db-rt

  DbSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet1
  DbSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet2
  DbSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet3

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref AppRouteTableAz1
        - !Ref AppRouteTableAz2
        - !Ref AppRouteTableAz3
        - !Ref DbRouteTable
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource: "*"

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/vpc/flowlogs/${NamePrefix}-${VPC}
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogsRetentionDays

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-vpc-flow-logs-role-${AWS::Region}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: vpc-flow-logs-to-cloudwatch
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutRetentionPolicy
                Resource: "*"

  VpcFlowLogs:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceType: VPC
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-vpc-flow-logs

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-VpcId
  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of public subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2, !Ref PublicSubnet3]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnets
  AppSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of application subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref AppSubnet1, !Ref AppSubnet2, !Ref AppSubnet3]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-AppSubnets
  DbSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of database subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref DbSubnet1, !Ref DbSubnet2, !Ref DbSubnet3]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DbSubnets
  PublicRouteTableId:
    Description: Public route table ID
    Value: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  AppRouteTableIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of application route table IDs
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref AppRouteTableAz1, !Ref AppRouteTableAz2, !Ref AppRouteTableAz3]]
  DbRouteTableId:
    Description: Database route table ID
    Value: !Ref DbRouteTable

    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/vpc/flowlogs/${NamePrefix}-${VPC}
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogsRetentionDays

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-vpc-flow-logs-role-${AWS::Region}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: vpc-flow-logs-to-cloudwatch
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutRetentionPolicy
                Resource: "*"

  VpcFlowLogs:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceType: VPC
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs

Outputs:
  VpcId:

    Value: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnetIds:

    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2, !Ref PublicSubnet3]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnets
  AppSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of application subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref AppSubnet1, !Ref AppSubnet2, !Ref AppSubnet3]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-AppSubnets
  DbSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of database subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref DbSubnet1, !Ref DbSubnet2, !Ref DbSubnet3]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DbSubnets
  PublicRouteTableId:
    Description: Public route table ID
    Value: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  AppRouteTableIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of application route table IDs
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref AppRouteTableAz1, !Ref AppRouteTableAz2, !Ref AppRouteTableAz3]]
  DbRouteTableId:
    Description: Database route table ID
    Value: !Ref DbRouteTable

message.content:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Three-tier VPC across three Availability Zones with public, application, and database subnets, NAT gateways, routing, S3 gateway endpoint, and VPC flow logs.

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: three-tier
    Description: Prefix used for resource names and tags.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  PublicSubnetCidrs:
    Type: List<AWS::EC2::CIDR>
    Default:
      - 10.0.0.0/20
      - 10.0.16.0/20
      - 10.0.32.0/20
    Description: CIDR blocks for the public subnets across three AZs.
  AppSubnetCidrs:
    Type: List<AWS::EC2::CIDR>
    Default:
      - 10.0.128.0/20
      - 10.0.144.0/20
      - 10.0.160.0/20
    Description: CIDR blocks for the application subnets across three AZs.
  DbSubnetCidrs:
    Type: List<AWS::EC2::CIDR>
    Default:
      - 10.0.192.0/20
      - 10.0.208.0/20
      - 10.0.224.0/20
    Description: CIDR blocks for the database subnets across three AZs.
  FlowLogsRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 90
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 3653
    Description: CloudWatch Logs retention in days for VPC Flow Logs.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-vpc
        - Key: Tier
          Value: network

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-igw

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Ref PublicSubnetCidrs]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-public-az1
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public
  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Ref PublicSubnetCidrs]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-public-az2
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public
  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Ref PublicSubnetCidrs]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-public-az3
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  AppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Ref AppSubnetCidrs]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-app-az1
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application
  AppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Ref AppSubnetCidrs]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-app-az2
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application
  AppSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Ref AppSubnetCidrs]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-app-az3
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application

  DbSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Ref DbSubnetCidrs]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-db-az1
        - Key: Tier
          Value: database
  DbSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Ref DbSubnetCidrs]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-db-az2
        - Key: Tier
          Value: database
  DbSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Ref DbSubnetCidrs]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-db-az3
        - Key: Tier
          Value: database

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-public-rt

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3

  NatEipAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-nat-eip-az1
  NatEipAz2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-nat-eip-az2
  NatEipAz3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-nat-eip-az3

  NatGatewayAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEipAz1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-nat-az1
  NatGatewayAz2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEipAz2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-nat-az2
  NatGatewayAz3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEipAz3.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-nat-az3

  AppRouteTableAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-app-rt-az1
  AppRouteTableAz2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-app-rt-az2
  AppRouteTableAz3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-app-rt-az3

  AppDefaultRouteAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableAz1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayAz1
  AppDefaultRouteAz2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableAz2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayAz2
  AppDefaultRouteAz3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableAz3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayAz3

  AppSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableAz1
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet1
  AppSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableAz2
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet2
  AppSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableAz3
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet3

  DbRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-db-rt

  DbSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet1
  DbSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet2
  DbSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet3

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref AppRouteTableAz1
        - !Ref AppRouteTableAz2
        - !Ref AppRouteTableAz3
        - !Ref DbRouteTable
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource: "*"

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/vpc/flowlogs/${NamePrefix}-${VPC}
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogsRetentionDays

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-vpc-flow-logs-role-${AWS::Region}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: vpc-flow-logs-to-cloudwatch
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutRetentionPolicy
                Resource: "*"

  VpcFlowLogs:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceType: VPC
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${NamePrefix}-vpc-flow-logs

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-VpcId
  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of public subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2, !Ref PublicSubnet3]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnets
  AppSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of application subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref AppSubnet1, !Ref AppSubnet2, !Ref AppSubnet3]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-AppSubnets
  DbSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of database subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref DbSubnet1, !Ref DbSubnet2, !Ref DbSubnet3]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DbSubnets
  PublicRouteTableId:
    Description: Public route table ID
    Value: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  AppRouteTableIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of application route table IDs
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref AppRouteTableAz1, !Ref AppRouteTableAz2, !Ref AppRouteTableAz3]]
  DbRouteTableId:
    Description: Database route table ID
    Value: !Ref DbRouteTable
